record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, strengthen history-item frequency attenuation from 1-0.3*feature to 1-0.4*feature, retaining feature=sqrt(log1p(training_count)/max_log_count). The regression at 0.2 motivates testing whether stronger suppression of common input items improves contextual discrimination. Use training counts only and preserve zero features for unseen items. Keep embedding design, topology, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer fixed; synchronize predictor behavior and retain one model per category.
